title: Scenario
text: A bank failed an audit: a three-year-old Db2 backup could not be traced. The synthetic estate here holds 222 month-end image copies for six objects.

title: Dashboard
text: The Db2 catalog only keeps limited history, so older backups vanish from it. Teal bars are recoverable only through ADDI lineage. Red marks two true gaps.

title: The problem
text: The search fell to developers, took days, pulled capacity from planned work, and left no repeatable evidence trail for the auditor.

title: The target
text: Locate and validate the backup in under 15 minutes, with 100% auditable traceability. Durations shown are illustrative.

title: Solution
text: Pick a preset scenario. Nobody types. The audit analyst asks for the general ledger backup of 30 November 2023.

title: IBM watsonx Assistant for Z (simulated)
text: The assistant interprets the request, checks the Db2 catalog, finds no row, and says why: history older than the retention window is gone.

title: IBM ADDI for IBM Z (simulated)
text: ADDI lineage identifies the COPY job that ran that night. The dataset is located on virtual tape with its volume serial.

title: Evidence
text: Integrity and a simulated recoverability dry run pass. The evidence package is sealed, every check with its source system and timestamp. Total: about five simulated minutes, well under the 15-minute target.

title: An honest answer
text: Not every question has a happy ending. For this object the job ran, but its dataset is missing everywhere.

title: Auditable either way
text: The tool does not invent a backup. It documents the gap with full evidence, so the audit conversation starts from facts, in minutes.

title: Results (illustrative targets)
text: From days of developer effort to a repeatable, auditable trace by the audit or DBA team. Targets to be proven in a pilot, not measured results.

title: Architecture
text: A person asks in plain language. The simulated IBM watsonx Assistant for Z runs four steps: look up the catalog, find lineage when the catalog is empty, locate and validate the backup, and seal the evidence. The simulated ADDI supplies the lineage. A DBA reviews the evidence package.

title: What is deployed today
text: Only the demo web app and the evidence export are built. Assistant for Z and ADDI are simulated, no bank system is connected, and there is no REST API or watsonx.ai.

title: Conclusion and next steps
text: This demo shows the flow, not the products. The target of under 15 minutes with 100 percent auditable traceability is still to be proven. Next: agree the scope in a short Sprint 0, confirm what is possible with the product teams, measure today's baseline, then run a three to four week pilot on the bank's real systems. We need a DBA, an application owner, an audit reviewer and read-only access. The goal is to validate value with real data and define the path to scale.
